create_WerScorer: create a WerScorer instance with a WerScorerConfig to compute word error rate
add_string_WerScorer: add a reference and prediction string pair to the WerScorer for WER calculation
score_WerScorer: call score on a WerScorer to get the word error rate as a percentage
reset_WerScorer: reset a WerScorer instance to clear accumulated distance and reference length
result_string_WerScorer: call result_string on a WerScorer to get a formatted WER percentage string
